author: Bobby Grayson
description:
wf7/locals touched four functions another builder may own. All four edits are additive; none changes behaviour for a file with no local helper, and all ten Gen files regenerate byte for byte.

1) fail/1 (elixir/to_lean.exs, bottom of the module). It used to IO.puts + System.halt(2) unconditionally. It now checks Process.get(:to_lean_dry) first and, when that is set, throws {:to_lean_dry, msg} instead. The flag is set only inside collect_local_uses/2, the pass that renders everything once with unknown helper signatures purely to see the types the helpers are called at; errors there are swallowed because the real pass reports them. Outside that pass the behaviour is unchanged. Merge note: keep the guard, take whatever else the other branch does to the message.

2) expr/3 gained ONE clause, placed immediately after the "defp expr(_env, nil, nil)" clause and BEFORE the "Option <> inner" clause:
     defp expr(env, {:__local_call__, _, [id | args]}, t), do: local_call_str(env, id, args, t)
It must stay before the Option clause, which would otherwise wrap an Option-returning helper in a spurious "some". The head :__local_call__ is a private node this branch introduces (rewrite_local_calls/4 puts it there before anything else runs), so the clause cannot shadow any real Elixir form: a builder adding <>, &&, || or "in" clauses anywhere in expr/3 is unaffected, in either merge order.

3) type_of/2 gained ONE clause just before the final "defp type_of(_env, _), do: nil", returning the helper's result type for a :__local_call__ node. Same argument: private head, shadows nothing.

4) render/2: one interpolation added to the output heredoc, ctx.local_decls, between the pid constants and sig. ctx.local_decls is the empty string for every file with no reachable helper.

Also: Ctx gained three fields (locals, local_specs, local_decls); main/1 rewrites the module bodies before collect_raw_types and calls local_sigs/2 and render_locals/1 just before render/2; init_of/3 now returns a 4-tuple {param, expr, subs, notes} instead of a 3-tuple, and its only callers are main/1 and infer_types/2 (the latter reads elem(init, 1) and is unaffected).

In elixir/readiness.exs: defined_funs/1 now registers the lower arities default arguments make a function callable at; check_expr/3 gained one cond branch (a call to a helper of this module is not a finding); the statement checker gained two cond branches (a helper already reported at its definition is silent, otherwise "local helper called as a statement"); check_types/2 gained one cond branch for the inferred state shape; check_init/4 was rewritten.
title: cross-area edit: fail/1, expr/3, type_of/2, render/2 in to_lean.exs
